MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The step drill bits felt like a natural next choice because they add larger hole sizes for sheet-metal fastening work alongside my existing drill bits, rivets, and rivet nuts.",
    "The assorted screws and fender washers fit my repeated interest in versatile fastening supplies, while the magnetic drill hooks would help keep my tools accessible and the quick-setting glue would complement my epoxy and tapes for repairs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The mushroom filter patches have an adhesive backing, but their purpose has no connection to the repairs and assembly work reflected in my recent choices.",
    "The door rack and ceiling hooks solve household hanging needs I have not shown. The drill hooks appeal to me specifically because they organize workshop tools.",
    "The single-size screws and three-inch bolt sets are relevant, but I would wait for a project requiring those dimensions; the assorted screw kit is useful across more of my current work."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Having hooks or being used for hanging seems to have been treated as enough of a connection, even though what I need to hang and where I use it matter.",
    "Shared features such as adhesive backing or stainless-steel construction seem to carry too much weight when the actual use or dimensions do not fit my needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent rivets, rivet nuts, bolts, measuring tools, and cutting wheels point toward making and fastening parts; supplies that support the next step in that work feel especially useful.",
    "I repeatedly choose assortments, so a range of usable sizes is more compelling than a narrowly specified fastener without an immediate project.",
    "I value additions that extend what my existing tools and supplies can do, such as step bits for larger holes, rather than merely resembling something I already bought."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my workshop and fastening interests, but sometimes confused shared product features with a shared practical purpose."
}
